reviews.title: Most Popups I’ve Ever Seen
reviews.text: Gameplay is fine.   Just deleted the app after less than a week.  I hadn’t played in 48 hours and when I launched the app I was greeted by an offer.  Or a reward.  Or something other than the actual game, which is completely fine and normal for any app.  Then there was a second pop.  Then a 3rd.  Mind you, I was skipping everything I could when offered by the pop.  Then a fourth.  Then a fifth. Then a sixth.  THIRTEEN pop offers, rewards, daily specials, etc. and I still wasn’t at the game.  I stopped at 13 and deleted the app, so God knows how many more popups I would have had to deal with if I kept going.  Keep the popups to 5 or less on launch and I would still be playing.  Gameplay is good.

reviews.title: Support
reviews.text: Support stinks! I sent an email to support about the lag time, delayed play and game clocking with almost everything I did. That was over 2 weeks ago! I still have to hear back from them. I got the confirmation email saying they got it. I follow up with another email middle of last week and no confirmation email and no response. It’s a shame since I like the game but support is killing it! Without support your game is only as good as it plays so if there are problems the game is no good. So I do believe I will be quitting now. Have fun trying to contact support!
